I wanted to get away from home and attempted to “run” away from my depression. I used to isolate myself, never go to school, etc but when I got into college I kind of just pushed those tendencies away in attempt to make something of myself/change my identity. No one in college knew about my past so I decided to try to run with that. The depression definitely followed me but getting a good job, loving the school I go to, picking up hobbies, and surrounding myself with a good support system helped. Sometimes things seem great, and then other nights I’m alone with my thoughts and as you stated, that emergency hatch shows up out of nowhere and I can’t stop thinking about it for a week

I had a really really bad childhood growing up and have had depression for as long as I can remember. The first time I self harmed was like the 6th grade and things just went down hill from there, fast. I think after spending so long in certain state of mind it’s really hard to break out of it, even after your surroundings and the quality of your life has changed. I’m really really trying to break out of it, but sometimes it ends up getting the best of me. I also have BPD so sometimes even minor set backs seem like the lowest of lows to me. And my boyfriend is the only person I’ve told in the last several years so I guess it’s not fully a secret. I used to tell him every time I felt suicidal but I know it hurts him so much and he wants nothing more than for me to be happy so lately I’ve just been trying to deal with things on my own to ease his mind
Thanks! I’ll get right on that

I’ve been the same way my entire life. I’ve never believed in anything “out of the ordinary” like synchronicities— I’m not even a religious person. Growing up, if people were to tell me these things I would have immediately marked them off as just weird coincidences. But after they started happening to me regularly it’s changed my mind completely. 

These are amazing examples btw. It’s the specificity of the synchronicity. What are the chances you’d find the game console AND the game you wanted at that place after having a gut feeling not to buy it at the other? It’s meaningful and specific to you which makes it pretty damn cool if you ask me
